dataset_metadata.purpose: Offline symptom terminology normalization, structured intake, red-flag routing and educational summaries.
dataset_metadata.review_status: DRAFT — MUST BE REVIEWED BY A REGISTERED MEDICAL PRACTITIONER BEFORE CLINICAL DEPLOYMENT

hard_rules: Run red-flag detection before the first question and after every patient answer.
Emergency red flags immediately stop routine questions and show emergency guidance.
Never say a disease is confirmed from symptom matching.
Do not calculate disease probabilities; no validated likelihood model is included.
Unknown or ambiguous phrases must trigger clarification, not a guessed match.
Never recommend prescription drugs, antibiotics, steroids or individualized doses.
Use extra caution for infants, children, pregnancy, older adults and immunocompromised patients.
Absence of a red-flag phrase does not prove that the patient is safe.
Clinician review is mandatory before real-world clinical use.

patient_intake_questionnaire.title: Patient Symptom Assessment
patient_intake_questionnaire.intro: I’ll ask a few questions to understand what you are experiencing. This is not a medical diagnosis.

questions.text: Are you having severe difficulty breathing, severe chest pain, fainting, or sudden weakness on one side?

translations.hi: क्या साँस लेने में बहुत कठिनाई, तेज़ सीने में दर्द, बेहोशी या शरीर के एक तरफ अचानक कमजोरी है?
translations.hinglish: क्या साँस लेने में बहुत कठिनाई, तेज़ सीने में दर्द, बेहोशी या शरीर के एक तरफ अचानक कमजोरी है?

questions.text: Is pregnancy possible or are you currently pregnant?

translations.hi: क्या गर्भावस्था संभव है या आप गर्भवती हैं?
translations.hinglish: क्या गर्भावस्था संभव है या आप गर्भवती हैं?

questions.text: Which symptoms are you experiencing? Select all that apply.

translations.hi: आपको कौन-कौन से लक्षण हैं? सभी चुनें।
translations.hinglish: आपको कौन-कौन से लक्षण हैं? सभी चुनें।

questions.text: Are symptoms getting better, staying the same, or worsening?

translations.hi: लक्षण बेहतर हो रहे हैं, वैसे ही हैं या बढ़ रहे हैं?
translations.hinglish: लक्षण बेहतर हो रहे हैं, वैसे ही हैं या बढ़ रहे हैं?

questions.text: How severe is the main symptom right now?

translations.hi: अभी मुख्य लक्षण कितना गंभीर है?
translations.hinglish: अभी मुख्य लक्षण कितना गंभीर है?

questions.text: Where exactly do you feel the symptom?

translations.hi: लक्षण शरीर के किस हिस्से में है?
translations.hinglish: लक्षण शरीर के किस हिस्से में है?

questions.text: Is the symptom constant or does it come and go?

translations.hi: लक्षण लगातार है या आता-जाता है?
translations.hinglish: लक्षण लगातार है या आता-जाता है?

questions.text: Do you have any other symptoms along with this?

translations.hi: इसके साथ कोई और लक्षण भी हैं?
translations.hinglish: इसके साथ कोई और लक्षण भी हैं?

questions.text: Do you have any long-term medical conditions?

translations.hi: क्या आपको पहले से कोई बीमारी है?
translations.hinglish: क्या आपको पहले से कोई बीमारी है?

questions.text: Are you taking any medicines or supplements?

translations.hi: क्या आप कोई दवा या सप्लीमेंट ले रहे हैं?
translations.hinglish: क्या आप कोई दवा या सप्लीमेंट ले रहे हैं?

questions.text: Do you have any known allergies, especially to medicines?

translations.hi: क्या आपको किसी दवा या चीज़ से एलर्जी है?
translations.hinglish: क्या आपको किसी दवा या चीज़ से एलर्जी है?

questions.text: Has anyone around you had a similar illness recently?

translations.hi: क्या आसपास किसी को हाल में ऐसे लक्षण हुए हैं?
translations.hinglish: क्या आसपास किसी को हाल में ऐसे लक्षण हुए हैं?

questions.text: Are you able to eat, drink, sleep and do usual activities?

translations.hi: क्या आप खाना, पानी, नींद और रोज़ के काम सामान्य रूप से कर पा रहे हैं?
translations.hinglish: क्या आप खाना, पानी, नींद और रोज़ के काम सामान्य रूप से कर पा रहे हैं?

questions.text: Is there anything else a clinician should know?

translations.hi: क्या कोई और बात है जो डॉक्टर को पता होनी चाहिए?
translations.hinglish: क्या कोई और बात है जो डॉक्टर को पता होनी चाहिए?

red_flag_rules.message: Severe breathing difficulty can be an emergency. Seek emergency medical help now.
Severe or pressure-like chest pain can be an emergency. Seek emergency medical help now.
Possible stroke warning signs require immediate emergency assessment. Note when symptoms began.
Reduced consciousness or repeated fainting requires emergency help.
A first, prolonged or repeated seizure, injury, pregnancy, or failure to recover requires emergency help. Do not restrain or put anything in the mouth.
Bleeding of this type needs urgent in-person assessment.
Possible severe allergic reaction. Seek emergency help immediately.
A sudden, extremely severe headache needs emergency assessment.
New or sudden confusion can indicate a serious condition and needs urgent assessment.
Possible significant dehydration needs prompt assessment, especially in children and older adults.
Severe pain or heavy bleeding during pregnancy requires urgent in-person assessment.
Stay with a trusted person, move away from means of harm, and contact local emergency or crisis support now.

sections.label: Possible patterns to discuss with a clinician
sections.disclaimer: These are possible associations only. Symptoms overlap across many conditions. This is not a diagnosis or probability ranking.

assessment_result_template.footer: Med44 provides health information and structured intake support. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace a qualified healthcare professional.

offline_matching_policy.negation: Detect negation such as 'no fever' and 'bukhar nahi' before recording a symptom.
offline_matching_policy.multi_symptom: Store each symptom independently; do not force one condition.
offline_matching_policy.unknown_input: I’m not confident I understood that symptom. Can you describe where you feel it and what it feels like?
offline_matching_policy.confidence: Do not expose text-similarity scores as clinical confidence.

references.title: AHA / American Red Cross 2024 First Aid Guidelines

implementation_notes.database: Import into SQLite as versioned reference tables. Preserve dataset version and source URL.
